provenance.input_limitations: Plan-derived preparation only. No original incident timelines, consented journey traces, device/provider results, baseline burden, independent event labels or human review supplied. No real thresholds or pilot acceptance established.

scopes.retest_before_extension: Before enabling another country/language/route/device combination, repeat applicable timeline/baseline, contact-tolerance, human-factors, device/channel and deterministic cases; obtain independent disposition and a new revision. No region-wide transfer.

sources.limitations: Not an incident, measurement, independent review or empirical acceptance record

baselines.description: Register existing WhatsApp/call/contact practice and simplest fixed policy before comparing adaptation; no baseline measured.

thresholds.name: T_action
thresholds.measurement_definition: Latest useful appropriate contact action time; start event and uncertainty reconstruction remain UNSET.

thresholds.name: Delta_action
thresholds.measurement_definition: Minimum worthwhile improvement against scoped current-practice baseline; comparison and variation require evidence.

thresholds.name: B_false
thresholds.measurement_definition: Maximum tolerable unnecessary escalations divided by all registered active trip-hours, including outages.

thresholds.name: B_attention
thresholds.measurement_definition: Interaction limit; unit, observation window and counting of attention costs require independent human-factors review.

claims.claim_or_constraint: A bounded check-in can obtain useful status without unsafe distraction.

test.procedure: Compare simplest fixed policy, current contact practice and proposed bounded policy; record delivered/eligible prompts, information gained, attention and adverse cases. See STPA.md cases C01-C04 and C07.

acceptance.criterion: Independent review must establish useful information and safe interaction within scoped B_attention; G1 applies. Proposed criterion awaiting evidence and independent human-factors review.

claims.disposition_reason: No source results or independent disposition collected

claims.claim_or_constraint: Escalation can get appropriate trusted-contact action sooner than current arrangements under supported conditions.

test.procedure: Reconstruct baseline and proposed action timelines with uncertainty; distinguish provider receipt, contact acknowledgement and useful action. Include unavailable contacts, late/duplicate delivery and gaps. See C01-C03 and C05.

acceptance.criterion: Independent review must support action within T_action, improvement at least Delta_action and unnecessary escalation burden at most B_false over all active trip-hours; G2-G4 apply. Proposed, unaccepted criterion.

claims.disposition_reason: No source results or independent disposition collected

claims.claim_or_constraint: Contributed observations can describe response patterns; stronger fatigue/crime/road-risk claims need independent outcomes.

test.procedure: Compare attributed observations and separately independently labelled outcomes; report exposure, missingness, policy-induced sampling, consent and privacy limits. See C06-C09. Shared-data release remains a later conditional gate.

acceptance.criterion: Independent reviewer must be able to reproduce bounded descriptive results and uncertainty using qualified exposure. No robbery/fatigue harm-reduction claim from this kit; independent labels and later data gates remain required. Proposed, unaccepted criterion.

claims.disposition_reason: No source results or independent disposition collected

deterministic_gates.claim_or_constraint: No forced screen interaction to prevent an alarm while moving.

test.procedure: C04: propose replay of moving driver who cannot look/tap/type; check alarm policy does not require a screen response to avoid escalation.

acceptance.criterion: Zero cases requiring screen interaction to prevent an alarm while moving; scripted results establish tested cases only.

deterministic_gates.disposition_reason: No source results or independent disposition collected

test.procedure: C05: propose both orderings of committed resolution versus dispatch, delayed closure and duplicate/restarted jobs; distinguish provider acceptance before resolution from new dispatch after it.

acceptance.criterion: Zero obsolete escalations initiated after committed resolution. Record earlier provider acceptance and reconciliation; do not promise recall.

deterministic_gates.disposition_reason: No source results or independent disposition collected

test.procedure: C03/C06: propose no reply, liveness only, delivery only, contact acknowledgement, old OK self-report and fatigue/security suspicion cases.

acceptance.criterion: No observation or missed reply becomes confirmed wellbeing, robbery or sleep. Preserve attributed time-specific reports, suspicion, unknown and independent corroboration.

test.procedure: C09: propose explicit security event with unconsented contact, withdrawn access, stale link and excess cargo/route detail.

acceptance.criterion: Zero unauthorised route/cargo disclosures, including during a security event; consent scope, recipient and freshness must be evidenced.
